fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: Raw Internet Archive id_ replay of a fixed capture, fetched with plain curl (no Accept-Encoding, no decoding). First downloaded on 2026-09-28T18:08:02Z; downloaded again at 2026-09-28T18:59:15Z, 2026-09-28T19:05:15Z, the last at least 30 minutes after the first, each with the same byte count and SHA-256 (17511 bytes). The base32 SHA-1 of the bytes equals the Internet Archive's CDX digest for the capture.
